text:
Maya R: Heads up — ~6k unacknowledged accounting batches in accounting-shim since 03:10 UTC. Invoice preview shows spikes for some tenants. Anyone on this?

Jon H: saw that. appears tied to far-edge shard that got the sampler-v2 rollout at 00:45 UTC.

Sasha: timeline + any shim-layer lease/ack PRs?

Lee: fast-ack was reverted, but we kept the concat-reassembly change. suspect reassembly <> redis-lock TTL mismatch.

Maya R: logs excerpt: 
```
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z accounting-shim WARN lease expired batch=shard-42/seq=98765
2026-02-18T03:12:04Z accounting-shim INFO requeueing batch=shard-42/seq=98765 attempts=4
2026-02-18T03:12:05Z aggregator ERROR duplicate-insert tenant=acme-co batch=98765
```

Priya: that means lease TTL < reassembly time => requeue while previous still committing => duplicates.

Jon H: current redis lock TTL is 3s, reassembly under load can be ~7-9s. Can we bump TTL immediately?

Sasha: I can push hotfix to set TTL=15s and add lease_expired_total metric + reassembly_ms histogram.

Maya R: do it. Notify support to pause invoice-previews for flagged tenants while we validate.

deploy-bot: started deploy accounting-shim/lease-ttl-hotfix -> aws/ecs/us-west-2 (canary: shard-42)

Lee: medium-term: change reassembly to stream partials to aggregator with idempotency keys instead of whole-batch requeues.

Priya: agreed. quick tasks: add reassembly_ms histogram, lease_expired_total counter (shard label), surface on Console alerts.

Sasha: traces show fetch-remainder RPC sometimes >8s. attaching trace ids to ticket.

SupportBot: ticket PENDING-3421 created (tenants: acme-co, beta-svc, test-tenant-7).

Jon H: after canary, run targeted reconcile to dedupe duplicates: `./scripts/reconcile_batches --shard 42 --dry-run`

Maya R: postmortem notes: root cause = redis TTL too low given sampler-v2 ordering change; short fix = TTL -> 15s; medium = metrics + console alert; long = streaming partials + idempotent aggregator tests.

deploy-bot: canary succeeded on shard-42; TTL updated to 15s (rollout 1/5 shards).

Sasha: lease_expired_total dropped to ~0 on canary. occasional reassembly spikes remain but under TTL.

Jon H: schedule ramp for remaining shards over 2h; monitor duplicate-insert rate + invoice-preview deltas.

Priya: I'll add Console card under Billing / Metering and write runbook to pause invoice-preview.

Lee: I'll open PR to add idempotency keys + integration test that replays interleaved partials.

Maya R: oncall playbook: if invoice-preview > baseline+25% for >10m, revert sampler-v2 on flagged shards. I'll post a short incident summary in #incidents once stable.

Jon H: can we add dashboard showing reassembly p95 vs lease TTL during rollouts?

Sasha: yes—adding p50/p95/p99 panels and linking to rollout playbook.

Maya R: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
